''See also: [[Timaias Adama Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Timaias Adama, also known as Adama, was a [[Sage]] who resided as a guest at the [[Heaven’s Glory School{{!}}Heaven's Glory School]] for nearly three months. Despite being mistaken by students for a [[Gold]], he held the higher title of [[Sage]] and viewed many of the school's elders with contempt. He possessed a [[Steelborn body{{!}}Steelborn Iron body]] and was skilled in swordplay, which he used to defend himself against opponents armed with makeshift clubs. During a confrontation involving several [[Jades]], Adama sustained significant injuries to his head and back from club strikes and [[madra]] attacks. He ultimately sacrificed his life for [[Yerin]], resulting in her inheriting his [[Remnant]]. It is suggested that a person would need to reach the rank of [[Archlord]] to become his true successor.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Timaias Adama possesses an [[Archlord]] body along with a [[Steelborn body{{!}}Steelborn Iron body]]. His physical form is further characterized by flesh infused with [[soulfire]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Adama sacrificed his life for [[Yerin]], who subsequently took his [[Remnant]]. It is suggested that he may have influenced the development of [[Yerin's Blood Shadow]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Known as the [[Sage of the Endless Sword]] and the [[Sword Sage]], he utilizes a [[wintersteel]] blade. He also maintains a [[void space]] containing experimental materials and ancient research notes.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Guest at Heaven's Glory}} ===
